2607.21284.title: news-crawler-LM: A Small Long-Context Model For High-Quality News Crawling
2607.21284.paper_summary: Extracting structured content from news pages remains challenging due to heterogeneous HTML layouts, inconsistent markup, and substantial boilerplate such as navigation elements and advertisements. Rule-based news crawlers can achieve high extraction accuracy by encoding site-specific structure, but require manual configuration in order to generalize to new publishers. Large language models provide a more flexible alternative by reducing the need for handcrafted rules, but their high computational cost limits practical deployment. In this paper, we introduce news-crawler-LM, a small long-context language model fine-tuned on high-quality, human-validated extractions from the Fundus news-crawling library. Our model converts raw HTML into plaintext and structured JSON, including fields such as headline, author, publication date, and article body. In our experiments, news-crawler-LM outperforms strong baselines in HTML-to-Markdown and HTML-to-JSON extraction, improving performance by +4.8 BLEU and +6.1 METEOR in the HTML-to-Markdown task, and by +2.2 BLEU and +4.1 METEOR in the HTML-to-JSON task. However, we also observe that our model only slightly better compared to other rule-based parsing libraries on the HTML-to-plaintext task in evaluations on previously unseen publishers. We release all models and artifacts to the research community.
2607.21284.paper_summary_zh: 從新聞頁面提取結構化內容仍然具有挑戰性，這是由於異質的 HTML 佈局、不一致的標記以及大量的樣板內容，例如導航元素和廣告。基於規則的新聞爬蟲可以通過編碼特定網站的結構來實現高提取準確性，但需要手動配置以便能夠推廣到新的出版商。大型語言模型提供了一種更靈活的替代方案，減少了對手工規則的需求，但其高計算成本限制了實際部署。在本文中，我們介紹了 news-crawler-LM，這是一個小型長上下文語言模型，經過高質量、人為驗證的提取數據進行微調，這些數據來自 Fundus 新聞爬蟲庫。我們的模型將原始 HTML 轉換為純文本和結構化的 JSON，包括標題、作者、出版日期和文章正文等字段。在我們的實驗中，news-crawler-LM 在 HTML 到 Markdown 和 HTML 到 JSON 的提取中超越了強基準，在 HTML 到 Markdown 任務中性能提高了 +4.8 BLEU 和 +6.1 METEOR，在 HTML 到 JSON 任務中性能提高了 +2.2 BLEU 和 +4.1 METEOR。然而，我們也觀察到，在對之前未見的出版商進行評估時，我們的模型在 HTML 到純文本任務上僅比其他基於規則的解析庫稍好。我們將所有模型和工件釋放給研究社群。
